notes: Is update me: About PrimeFeed me naya parichay text aaya hai — hamari desk khabrein kaise taiyaar karti hai aur har khabar ko bharosemand sroton se jaanch kar hi chhapti hai; hum users ka koi personal data nahi lete. Splash aur About par nayi line: 'Hindi & English News • Trusted News Experience'. Saath me kuch andar ke sudhaar bhi hain jisse app aur behtar chalega.
